# Tetelestai

> Tetelestai (Tetelestai Soluções em Tecnologia Ltda., CNPJ 58.138.258/0001-39) offers AI and automation for law firms and notary and registry offices (cartórios) in the Federal District, Brazil: WhatsApp customer service, scheduling and documents, with the data kept in the client's own account. It is based in Brasília and works online across Brazil. It also builds websites and landing pages, publishes its own iOS apps and runs Exato Teor, a product that transcribes WhatsApp conversations for notarial records. Contact is through WhatsApp (+55 61 98471-1930) or contato@tetelestai.tech.

## Key facts

- The first step is a free diagnosis: 30 to 45 minutes, by video or on-site visit, ending in a written proposal with three options (what each includes, price and timeline). No promise of results.
- Four fronts, chosen by the client: first-contact service on WhatsApp, scheduling and a dashboard, document automation, and team training in AI.
- Price: from R$ 2,500 in setup plus R$ 500 a month. Setup is paid in two parts, 50% on acceptance and 50% on delivery. The monthly fee covers the weekly review of the conversations by a person, adjustments and support. Minimum of 3 months of monthly fees; after that, cancellation with 30 days' notice and no fee. The agent platform and the WhatsApp API stay in the client's account and are paid separately.
- WhatsApp is automated only through the official WhatsApp API, with no mass messaging. The tools are contracted in the name of the firm or the notary office, so they stay with the client if the contract ends.
- For law firms, the agent follows the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) Provimento 205/2021: it answers first questions and collects data and documents, does not answer legal consultations and does not discuss fees. For notary offices, the tools stay in the office's account under the responsibility of its titular notary and follow the Federal District notary offices' Code of Norms.
- The technical side is led by a software engineer with 14 years of technical leadership in banking. Tetelestai has delivered 5 client websites and published 2 iOS apps on the App Store.
- Tetelestai does not guarantee more clients or more notarial acts: it delivers faster service and a team with less repetitive work.
- Websites and landing pages remain available on their own pages. Landing page: R$ 297 upfront when hiring, plus R$ 97 a month from the first month. One page with up to 5 sections, an offer and copy written for the business, SEO and GEO optimization, mobile version, WhatsApp button and one round of revisions, live in up to 2 business days after the client sends texts and photos. The R$ 97 monthly fee covers hosting, SSL, backups, one update a month, a monthly report and basic local SEO; the .com.br domain is included for the first 12 months, registered in the business's name. There is no minimum term on the landing page: the client can cancel with 30 days' notice and no fee; when the notice ends the site leaves Tetelestai's hosting, the domain stays with the client and the site files are handed over.
- Multi-page websites, iOS and Android apps, software systems, automations and digital marketing management are quoted in writing after a conversation; they have no published price.
- Service is delivered online, in Portuguese or English.
